people.name: Sukhdev Singh
people.bio: A dedicated freedom fighter and communist activist who fought for the rights of the peasantry in the Begusarai region.

people.name: Navin Kumar Navin
people.bio: A prominent political figure from Bandwar, actively involved in local governance and community development in the Begusarai district.

people.name: Girija Singh
people.bio: A respected village elder who played a key role in building the Shaheed Ramchandra Dwar and was instrumental in the founding and development of the Vaani Vilas Pustakalaya library.

people.name: Mahant Surendra Das
people.photoAlt: Mahant Surendra Das of Bandwar Thakurbari
people.notableFor: Served Bandwar Thakurbari for over 40 years and preserved the 200+ year old Krishna Janmashtami Mela
people.journey: Born in 1965 in Khamhar, he left home at the tender age of 13 to become an ascetic (baal sant) and went to Ayodhya. In 1985, he arrived in Bandwar with his guru (a panda from Ayodhya) to receive bhiksha. Captivated by the temple and the village, he chose to stay and devoted over 40 years of his life to the service of the deity at Bandwar Thakurbari.
people.bio: The revered Mahant of the historic Bandwar Thakurbari in Begusarai. A baal sant who left home at 13 and reached Bandwar in 1985 with his Ayodhya-based guru, he served the temple and its deity for over four decades. Under his stewardship, the Thakurbari's 200+ year old Krishna Janmashtami Mela continued to flourish. He passed away on 29 October 2026, leaving behind a legacy of devotion, simplicity, and cultural preservation.

people.name: Ansh Kumar
people.bio: Ansh Kumar is a student hailing from Ward No. 7 in Bandwar village, Begusarai. He is currently pursuing his education and represents the young generation of the village. As a dedicated student, he is actively engaged in his academic pursuits, contributing to the growing educational landscape of Bandwar.
